From 9569ff1a188fe48b46eb1ac2ae4543c271e0d4c2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jun 2022 09:39:24 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915: Fix error code in icl_compute_combo_phy_dpll()
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

This function is supposed to return zero or negative error codes but it
accidentally returns true on failure.

Fixes: 92a020747d6c ("drm/i915: Split shared dpll .get_dplls() into compute and get phases")
Signed-off-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjälä <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/YrVcHArNMTGCSy+9@kili
Reviewed-by: José Roberto de Souza <jose.souza@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dpll_mgr.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dpll_mgr.c
index ddae7e42ac46..118598c9a809 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dpll_mgr.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dpll_mgr.c
@@ -3184,7 +3184,7 @@ static int icl_compute_combo_phy_dpll(struct intel_atomic_state *state,
 	struct icl_port_dpll *port_dpll =
 		&crtc_state->icl_port_dplls[ICL_PORT_DPLL_DEFAULT];
 	struct skl_wrpll_params pll_params = {};
-	bool ret;
+	int ret;
 
 	if (intel_crtc_has_type(crtc_state, INTEL_OUTPUT_HDMI) ||
 	    intel_crtc_has_type(crtc_state, INTEL_OUTPUT_DSI))
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dpll_mgr.c`**
   - Changed the type of the variable `ret` from `bool` to `int`. This modification allows the function to return integer error codes (zero or negative) instead of boolean values, which is necessary for proper error handling.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `intel_dpll_mgr.c` directly addresses a bug where the function `icl_compute_combo_phy_dpll()` was incorrectly returning a boolean value (true) on failure instead of an appropriate error code. By changing the variable type from `bool` to `int`, the function can now correctly return error codes, aligning its behavior with the expected return type for error handling in the codebase. This change is linked to a previous commit (92a020747d6c) that split the functionality of getting DPLLs, indicating that the error handling was not properly implemented in the refactored code.

Here is the commit message:
drm/i915: Fix error code in icl_compute_combo_phy_dpll()
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

This function is supposed to return zero or negative error codes but it
accidentally returns true on failure.

Fixes: 92a020747d6c ("drm/i915: Split shared dpll .get_dplls() into compute and get phases")
Signed-off-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjälä <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/YrVcHArNMTGCSy+9@kili
Reviewed-by: José Roberto de Souza <jose.souza@intel.com>

Here is the root cause:
The function `icl_compute_combo_phy_dpll()` was incorrectly returning a boolean value (true) on failure instead of an integer error code, which is required for proper error handling in the context of the function's intended use. This misalignment with the expected return type led to potential misinterpretation of the function's success or failure status.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int icl_compute_combo_phy_dpll(struct intel_atomic_state *state,
 				      struct intel_crtc *crtc)
 {
 	struct drm_i915_private *dev_priv = to_i915(crtc->base.dev);
 	struct intel_crtc_state *crtc_state =
 		intel_atomic_get_new_crtc_state(state, crtc);
 	struct icl_port_dpll *port_dpll =
 		&crtc_state->icl_port_dplls[ICL_PORT_DPLL_DEFAULT];
 	struct skl_wrpll_params pll_params = {};
-	bool ret;
+	int ret;
 
 	if (intel_crtc_has_type(crtc_state, INTEL_OUTPUT_HDMI) ||
 	    intel_crtc_has_type(crtc_state, INTEL_OUTPUT_DSI))
 		ret = icl_calc_wrpll(crtc_state, &pll_params);
 	else
 		ret = icl_calc_dp_combo_pll(crtc_state, &pll_params);
 
 	if (ret)
 		return ret;
 
 	icl_calc_dpll_state(dev_priv, &pll_params, &port_dpll->hw_state);
 
 	return 0;
 }

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
bool ret;
ret = icl_calc_wrpll(crtc_state, &pll_params);
```
Reason:
The variable `ret` is declared as a boolean type, which is intended to hold true or false values. However, the function `icl_calc_wrpll()` (and potentially `icl_calc_dp_combo_pll()`) is expected to return an integer error code. When these functions fail, they return a non-zero integer, which is incorrectly interpreted as `true` due to the boolean type of `ret`. This leads to a situation where the function `icl_compute_combo_phy_dpll()` may return a non-zero value (indicating an error) but is misinterpreted as a success.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
int ret;
ret = icl_calc_wrpll(crtc_state, &pll_params);
```
Reason:
Changing the type of `ret` from `bool` to `int` allows it to correctly store the integer error codes returned by `icl_calc_wrpll()` and `icl_calc_dp_combo_pll()`. This ensures that when an error occurs, the function can return the appropriate negative error code instead of a boolean value, aligning with the expected return type and improving error handling in the function.
